nodes.name: a
nodes.stdout:
ping: pong
call: [drpb@localhost,[2,1],{badrpc,nodedown}]
call_errors: [{badrpc,{'EXIT',{boom,stack}}},
              {badrpc,{'EXIT',bye}},
              ball,
              {badrpc,{'EXIT',returned}},
              {badrpc,{'EXIT',{undef,stack}}}]
timeouts: [{badrpc,timeout},slept]
block_call: [drpb@localhost,
             {badrpc,{'EXIT',bye}},
             {badrpc,timeout},
             {badrpc,nodedown}]
cast: [true,true]
cast_told: {told,drpb@localhost,cast}
async: [drpb@localhost,{badrpc,nodedown},timeout,slept,{value,5}]
late_replies: []
multicall: [{[drpa@localhost,drpb@localhost],[]},
            {[drpa@localhost,drpb@localhost],[nobody@localhost]},
            {[{badrpc,{'EXIT',bye}}],[]},
            {[],[drpb@localhost]}]
parallel: [[drpa@localhost,drpb@localhost,drpa@localhost],
           [{1,drpa@localhost},{2,drpb@localhost},{3,drpa@localhost}]]
everywhere: abcast
everywhere_told: {told,drpb@localhost,everywhere}
abcast: abcast
abcast_forwarded: {forwarded,drpb@localhost,abcast}
sbcast: [{[drpb@localhost],[nobody@localhost]},{[],[drpb@localhost]}]
sbcast_forwarded: {forwarded,drpb@localhost,sbcast}
server_call: [{answer,q},{error,nodedown},{error,nodedown}]
multi_server_call: [{[{answer,all},{answer,all}],[]},
                    {[{answer,two}],[nobody@localhost]},
                    {[],[drpb@localhost]}]
pinfo: {registered_name,drp_server}
erpc_call: [drpb@localhost,drpb@localhost,drpb@localhost,drpa@localhost]
erpc_errors: [{error,{erpc,noconnection}},
              {error,{exception,boom,stack}},
              {exit,{exception,bye}},
              {throw,ball},
              {error,{erpc,timeout}},
              {error,{exception,undef,stack}}]
erpc_multicall: [[{error,{exception,boom,stack}},
                  {error,{exception,boom,stack}},
                  {error,{erpc,noconnection}}],
                 [{ok,drpa@localhost},
                  {ok,drpb@localhost},
                  {error,{erpc,noconnection}}],
                 [{error,{erpc,timeout}}]]
erpc_cast: [ok,ok,ok]
erpc_told: [{told,drpb@localhost,erpc_cast},{told,drpb@localhost,multicast}]
receive_response: 3
wait_response: [no_response,{response,slept}]
other_node: {error,{erpc,noconnection}}
response_timeout: {error,{erpc,timeout}}
collected: [{one,drpb@localhost},
            {three,{erpc,noconnection}},
            {two,drpa@localhost}]
late_responses: []
halted: {badrpc,nodedown}
dist_rpc: ok
